raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 83 EUR-denominated rows, but silver_transactions casts amount without any currency conversion, so EUR amounts are summed as if they were USD in every gold table. raw_fx_rates has a single rate set (EUR=1.25, as of 2026-01-01) that covers every currency present, so amounts can be converted to USD in silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(round(t.amount * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = t.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
